macros.name: matrixAdd
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix as the addition of matrices m1 and m2.

macros.name: matrixConcatH
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by augmenting matrix m1 with matrix m2 horizontally.

macros.name: matrixConcatV
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by augmenting matrix m1 with matrix m2 vertically.

macros.name: matrixConjugate
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by taking the complex conjugate of each entry of matrix m1.

macros.name: matrixConjugateT
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by taking the transpose of matrix m1 and then the complex conjugate of each matrix entry.

macros.name: matrixCopy
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by copying values from matrix1.

macros.name: matrixDet
macros.doc: Gives the determinant of matrix m. It also supports matrices of complex numbers.

macros.name: matrixEql
macros.doc: Returns true if m1 = m2, otherwise returns false.

macros.name: matrixGaussJordan
macros.doc: The command \matrixGaussJordan is used to obtain Gauss-Jordan elimination of an augmented matrix.

macros.name: matrixGetElement
macros.doc: Gives an entry of matrix in the ith row and the jth column.

macros.name: matrixInvert
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by taking the inverse of matrix1.

macros.name: matrixMul
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by multiplying matrix m1 by matrix m2.

macros.name: matrixMulAddCol
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix mtx obtained by multiplying the ith column of matrix1 by a real or complex number and adding it to the jth column.

macros.name: matrixMulAddRow
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix mtx obtained by multiplying the ith row of matrix1 by a real or complex number and adding it to the jth row.

macros.name: matrixMulCol
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by multiplying the ith column of matrix1 by a real or complex number.

macros.name: matrixMulNum
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by multiplying each entry of matrix m1 by s real or complex number.

macros.name: matrixMulRow
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by multiplying the ith row of matrix1 by a real or complex number.

macros.name: matrixNormF
macros.doc: Calculates the Frobenius norm of a matrix.

macros.name: matrixNumCols
macros.doc: Gives the number of columns in a matrix.

macros.name: matrixNumRows
macros.doc: Gives the number of rows in a matrix.

macros.name: matrixOp
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by evaluating an expression.

macros.name: matrixPow
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by taking the ith power of matrix m1 (multiplying matrix m1 i times with itself).

macros.name: matrixRank
macros.doc: Gives the rank of matrix m. It also supports matrices of complex numbers.

macros.name: matrixRREF
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by taking the reduced row echelon form of matrix1.

macros.name: matrixSetElement
macros.doc: Set entry of a matrix in the ith row and jth column as val.

macros.name: matrixSub
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix as the subtraction of matrices m1 and m2.

macros.name: matrixSubmatrix
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix sm obtained by taking a submatrix of matrix m. Here i, j denotes the start row and start column, and k, l denotes the end row and end column for obtaining the submatrix.

macros.name: matrixSwapCols
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix mtx obtained by swapping the ith and jth columns of matrix m.

macros.name: matrixSwapRows
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix mtx obtained by swapping the ith and jth rows of matrix m1.

macros.name: matrixTrace
macros.doc: Gives the trace (sum of diagonal entries) of a square matrix.

macros.name: matrixTranspose
macros.doc: Defines a new matrix obtained by taking the transpose of matrix m1.

macros.name: vectorAdd
macros.doc: Defines a new vector as the addition of vectors v1 and v2.

macros.name: vectorCopy
macros.doc: Defines a new vector v obtained by copying coordinates of vector w.

macros.name: vectorCreateRandom
macros.doc: Creates a new vector v of dimension n with coordinates as random numbers from the interval [a, b].

macros.name: vectorCross
macros.doc: Defines a new vector obtained by taking the cross product of vectors v and w of dimension 3.

macros.name: vectorDot
macros.doc: Gives the dot product of two vectors: v and w. If v = (v1 , . . . , vn ) and w = (w1 , . . . , wn ) are defined over the field of real numbers, then it is evaluated as v1 · w1 + · · · + vn · wn .

macros.name: vectorEql
macros.doc: Returns true if v = w, otherwise returns false.

macros.name: vectorGetCoordinate
macros.doc: Gives the ith coordinate of vector.

macros.name: vectorMulNum
macros.doc: Defines a new vector obtained by multiplying each coordinate of a vector by number num.

macros.name: vectorOp
macros.doc: Defines a new vector obtained by evaluating an expression.

macros.name: vectorParse
macros.doc: Parses the coordinates of a vector defined over the field of real numbers.

macros.name: vectorSub
macros.doc: Defines a new vector as the subtraction of vectors v1 and v2.

macros.name: vectorSumNorm
macros.doc: Calculates the sum norm of a vector v. If v = (v1 , . . . , vn ) then it is given by |v1 | + · · · + |vn |.

macros.name: vectorSupNorm
macros.doc: Calculates the sup norm of a vector v. If v = (v1 , . . . , vn ) then it is given by max{|v1 |, . . . , |vn |}.
